name: Red Grunge Capitals
description: Heavy oxide-red block capitals printed badly on rough paper — broken edges, gaps eaten out of the strokes, and a fine spatter of ink around them. Made for revolutions, revolts and upheavals, where a clean serif would read as the wrong century.
phrase: a title set in heavy block capitals with square slab-free stems, no serifs and very low stroke contrast, in a deep oxide red, tracked a little tight on one line, every letter distressed as though printed badly on rough paper — edges broken and ragged, small pinholes and gaps eaten out of the strokes, one side of each stem worn thinner than the other — with a fine spatter of the same red ink speckled around the letters and thinning outward; flat and matte throughout with no outline, no bevel, no gradient, no drop shadow and no glow
